## About

This project analyzes 30+ years of healthcare spending and health outcome data from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) and the Kaiser Family Foundation (KFF). Using data visualization and regression modeling, we identified a greater need for preventative spending and analysis of racial/geographic disparities to improve efficency of healthcare spending allocation.

**Collaborators:** [Aiyana Brown](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aiyana-brown/)

### What I did

- Reviewed online sources to identify relevant, complete and credible data sources such as the Centers for Meidcare and Medicaid Services (CMS) and the Kaiser Family Foundation (KFF).

- Utilized Python packages (Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, scikitlearn) to visualize and model between state clinical spending and hospitalizations. 

- Translated findings into key recommendations for stakeholders (e.g. policy makers and public health professionals) and presented findings to audience of 30.
